verdict.rationale: Sentry documents an official hosted MCP server at mcp.sentry.dev that connects AI assistants for searching errors, analyzing performance, triaging issues, reading docs and managing projects. Connections can be scoped to an organization or project, and the probe independently confirms the server is documented there. MCP access is listed even on the free tier, and the docs and homepage direct users to set it up from agent conversations. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the MCP server working in practice.
